Third-party software bundled with the Clean Local Tools QR & Barcode Scanner.

1. jsQR v1.4.0
   Source: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
   Distributed file: qr-scanner/vendor/jsqr.min.js
   License: Apache License, Version 2.0
   Copyright: (c) 2017 Cosmo Wolfe
   Full license text: qr-scanner/vendor/APACHE-2.0.txt
   (also at https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)

   jsQR is used only as an on-device QR code decoding fallback. It runs
   entirely in the visitor's browser; it makes no network requests and
   sends no data anywhere.
